description: ​I am a first-year undergraduate engineering student with a strong foundation in Python, algorithmic problem-solving, and rapid prototyping from first principles. I specialize in turning complex, abstract concepts into working prototypes under tight hackathon deadlines, bringing a structured, hands-on approach to both technical and creative challenges.
summary: Our team created a written report about Earth locations that may be used for testing solar panels for Moon bases. It addresses the challenge by breaking issues with solar panels technologies into parts that may be tested on Earth. It is important for planing the construction of lunar bases due to the need in reliable solar panels as a source of energy.
details: Our project presents our ideas regarding potential locations for testing the essencial equipment. It prrsents locations not only that are alike moon, but also is a planned plave for solar panels improvement. Our project is intended to share our ideas with others to potentially solve the mentioned issues. We used SI to help us reserch the topic and elaborate our idea for the project. Our project is creative because it relies on our own idea and our curiosity to solve the problems.
